events.title: The Vercel Bug Bounty Program is now publicly available
events.description: In 2022, we launched a private bug bounty program through HackerOne. Over the last several years, we've worked with HackerOne's VIP program to refine our process, targets, and scope, onboarding thousands of their best researchers and hardening security across our platform. We've translated those learnings into several public bounty programs: The $1 million React2Shell hacker challenge The $1 million Vercel Sandbox hacker challenge Our OSS bug bounty program Today, we are combining our private and OSS bounty programs into a single, public Vercel bug bounty program .
